# 4 bedroom detached house for sale

> A good looking detached modern family house with well enclosed private garden and double garage in a tucked away position with easy access to the city, station and Kings School A modern detached family home situated at the end of Sarum Close, accessed via an extended private driveway serving just two properties offering a secluded setting.
